prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_catboost', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='best_single_by_validation'. Narrative: FT_catboost dominates across all dimensions: it has perfect trend correlation (1.0), highest seasonal correlation (0.5833), and lowest RMSE (670.43). Despite high model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 8.49) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.13), FT_catboost's consistent superiority across both folds (695.64 vs 645.22) and both horizons (219.08 early, 800.33 late) justifies selecting it as the single best model. The series shows concept drift and autocorrelated residuals, but FT_catboost handles both trend directions well.
